entries.ticket: FORMA-016: createShow takes a string or number branch as a text node (F5)
entries.note: Step 1, found 2026-10-15; assigned by the lead to FORMA-016. createShow(() => props.user.active, () => props.title): the branch returns a string. The walker renders the text; core's createShow inserts the branch's result as a Node and throws when it is a non-empty string (Chromium: parameter 1 is not of type 'Node'; Firefox and WebKit say the same of insertBefore), so core's render cannot be compared in those states. The compiler accepts the string branch.
